python - <<'PY'
import codecs, re, io
from dotenv.parser import (_double_quote_escapes, _single_quote_escapes,
                           decode_escapes, parse_stream)

print("double regex:", _double_quote_escapes.pattern)
print("single regex:", _single_quote_escapes.pattern)

samples = [r'\\', r"\'", r'\"', r'\a', r'\b', r'\f', r'\n', r'\r', r'\t', r'\v', r'\z', r'\$', r'\ ']
for s in samples:
    for name, rx in [("dbl", _double_quote_escapes), ("sgl", _single_quote_escapes)]:
        m = rx.fullmatch(s)
        out = codecs.decode(m.group(0), 'unicode-escape') if m else None
        print(f"{s!r:6} {name}: match={bool(m)!s:5} decoded={out!r}")

print("\n-- current decode_escapes output vs expected regex.sub --")
for text in [r'line\nnext', r'a\\nb', r"it\'s", r'unknown\z', r'\t\v\f\b\r\a']:
    for name, rx in [("dbl", _double_quote_escapes), ("sgl", _single_quote_escapes)]:
        cur = decode_escapes(rx, text)
        exp = rx.sub(lambda m: codecs.decode(m.group(0), 'unicode-escape'), text)
        print(f"{name} {text!r:18} current={cur!r:22} expected={exp!r}")

print("\n-- parse_stream behavior --")
for src in ['X="line\\nnext"\n', "X='line\\nnext'\n", "X='it\\'s'\n", 'X="say \\"hi\\""\n', 'X=line\\nnext\n']:
    rows = list(parse_stream(io.StringIO(src)))
    print(f"{src!r:26} -> value={rows[0].value!r}")
PY
